node: Employer-funded workforce training and education-benefit programs
summary: Layer 1B expansion for the employer-funded workforce training and education-benefit procurement node found a small set of US-listed mid-cap companies with plausible direct exposure to enterprise education procurement. The strongest underfollowed candidates are Strategic Education via Workforce Edge and employer-affiliated enrollment, Bright Horizons via EdAssist education-benefit administration, Grand Canyon Education via workforce-development and licensure-oriented educational agreements, and Adtalem via healthcare workforce pipeline partnerships. These names are not recommendations; they are research candidates for later evidence, pricing, and falsification layers.
